data.title: ADOPT ME 2D TUESDAY!
data.subtitle: 2X Bucks & XP!
data.description:
This calendar event marks your last chance for this day (it'll be back next week if you miss it!)

12:00am Pacific (5pm South Korea, 5pm Eastern Australia)
8:00am Pacific (4pm UK, 5pm Central Europe)
4:00pm Pacific (8pm Eastern USA)

It will show up for everyone logged in at that time, but once you get your box it won't show up again until the next week so you can pick the time that suits you!

All players get a FREE temporary 2D Kitty that gives 2X Bucks and XP!

Complete 20 Needs on the 2D Kitty to get a free 2D Box. Opening it gives a chance at a variety of rewards, including a 2D Kitty that's yours to keep!
